summary: Frontend-only check of /products: the new Layers of Intelligence section, the RAG steps, the agent cards, the grouped FAQ with JSON-LD, layout at 1920/800/768/390 px, and regressions (pilot form, trial links). Every requested item passed. No pilot leads were submitted.

issues: Because cards in a row are equal height, the shorter cards (e.g. Meeting & Voice next to Governed Agentic) end with large empty white space. This is expected from the spec and is cosmetic only.
Inside a card, the 'Deep Intelligence' pill often wraps onto its own line under the feature name. It is readable but looks uneven. Optional fix: put the pills on one line under the title.

action_items: Optional, pre-existing: src/components/MobilePerformanceOptimizer.js preloads /static/css/main.css and /static/js/main.js, which return 404 (CRA uses hashed filenames). These are the only console errors on the page. Remove the preloads or point them at the real files.
critical_code_review_comments: Products.js is 916 lines. Consider moving the FAQS/AGENTS/PLANS constants to src/data, as was done with orqyneLayers.js.

FAQ indexes come from FAQ_GROUPS order (about first, then layers in LAYERS order). They are not in LAYER_FAQS source order, so product-faq-question-9 is the first Delivery FAQ (RAID log). Keep this in mind in future tests.
Glossary keys and testids come from term.t. They are unique today, but a duplicate term would cause a React key collision.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: section order rag -> intelligence-layers-section -> agents; 9 layer cards with summaries, features, product pills and Deep pills (only layer-deep-tag-decision exists at card level); grid 3/2/1 columns with equal heights per row and no overflow at 390; Contact Sales opens the existing 'Book a call' host-picker modal (role=dialog), not a Calendly iframe; glossary collapsed by default, 33 terms in the HTML; rag-step-0..3 = Index/Retrieve/Answer/Approve; agent-card-0..5 with no -6; 10 FAQ groups with 26 questions, each answer toggles and only one opens at a time; FAQPage JSON-LD has 26 entries; all trial links go to https://orgainse.live with target=_blank.
